Class LessonsLearnedList

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearnedList
public class LessonsLearnedList extends Object

Title: LessonsLearnedList Class

Description: The LessonsLearnedList class represents a list of LessonsLearned objects retrieved from the persistent H2 database. LessonsLearned handles Create, Update, and Delete for a single lesson; this class handles Read for collections of lessons. One instance holds all lessons in the system; others hold subsets, such as one Contributor's lessons or the results of a keyword search.

all(String username) supports Contributor Stories 2 and 4 (list only the lessons I have added). get(int id) and get(String title) support Contributor Story 2 (examine a lesson more closely). all() and search(String query) anticipate the Phase 3 Viewer stories (list all lessons and keyword search).

  • Field Details

    • lessons

      private final List<LessonsLearned> lessons

      Attribute: lessons

      Description: The in-memory list of LessonsLearned objects held by this list.

      Source and rationale: The assignment requires a list class supporting CRUD for lists of lessons learned, including a persistent list of all lessons and subsets of it. The H2 database is the persistent store, this attribute holds a copy so the GUI can display, filter, and search lessons without querying the database for every action.

  • Constructor Details

    • LessonsLearnedList

      public LessonsLearnedList()

      Method: LessonsLearnedList()

      Description: This default constructor establishes an empty list. The list is populated from the database by calling refresh(), or by search() when a subset list is produced.

  • Method Details

    • refresh

      public void refresh(database.Database db)

      Method: void refresh(Database db)

      Description: Reloads the list with every lesson currently stored in the persistent database. This must be called after a lesson is created, updated, or deleted so the list shown to the Contributor matches what is stored.

      Parameters:
      db - is the existing database connection
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if db is null
      IllegalStateException - if the database is unable to return the lessons

    • search

      public LessonsLearnedList search(String query)

      Method: LessonsLearnedList search(String query)

      Description: Produces a new LessonsLearnedList containing the lessons whose title or description contains every keyword in the query. This is how subsets of all lessons are created.

      Parameters:
      query - represents the words or phrase being searched for
      Returns:
      a new LessonsLearnedList of matching lessons, or all lessons if the query is blank
